test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

I said to Taru, “Be careful when you go out.”

options.text: I told Taru be careful when she goes out.
I said to Taru be careful when you go out.
I told Taru to be careful when she went out.
I told Taru to be careful when I went out.

solution:
The correct answer is: **I told Taru to be careful when she went out.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'said' changes to 'told'
 
• **Go out** changes to **went out **in the indirect part.
 
• The pronoun '**you**' changes to '**she**' in the indirect part.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") is replaced with the preposition 'to' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letters.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

The indirect sentence is: *I told Taru to be careful when she went out.*
